name.en: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
name.kn: ಪ್ರಧಾನ ಮಂತ್ರಿ ಜೀವನ ಜ್ಯೋತಿ ಬಿಮಾ ಯೋಜನೆ

benefit.en: Life insurance cover for death due to any reason. One-year cover, renewable every year.

why.en: No insurance on file, and you have a bank account.
why.kn: ನಿಮಗೆ ವಿಮೆ ಇಲ್ಲ, ಮತ್ತು ಬ್ಯಾಂಕ್ ಖಾತೆ ಇದೆ.

eligibility_text.en: People aged 18 to 50 years with a bank or post office account who give consent to join and enable auto-debit. If you join on or before age 50, you can renew up to age 55.
